description: old input: hydrodynamic coupling FNPF -> FNPF (DIVEMesh H 10 44, B 92 61), as in FNPF nesting. Chain: fnpf_hdc_source writes free-surface state files (P 44 3) on 0-40 m, DIVEMesh converts them for the 10-30 m grid, this run reads them as wave input. Needs DIVEMesh with the REEF3D_<model>-State file names (fixed after DIVEMesh 29ec4eb).
